extracted.name: Roasted vegetables
extracted.description: Enjoy roasted veg as a healthy and colourful side dish. You can use any vegetables you like – this recipe is brilliant for clearing out the fridge
ingredient_lines: 1 red onion cut into thin wedges
instruction_lines: Tip the broccoli, sweet potatoes, red peppers, courgettes, onion, garlic and tomatoes into a bowl and add the olive oil along with plenty of salt and pepper.
Toss well, then tip onto a large baking tray or two smaller trays, ensuring everything is in an even layer.
Put in the oven and roast for 35-40 mins, tossing halfway, until cooked through and lightly caramelised.
